detailed_checks.implementation: crypto.randomBytes(32) generating 256-bit tokens
detailed_checks.verification: Cryptographically secure, non-predictable

detailed_checks.implementation: Timing-safe comparison with crypto.timingSafeEqual

detailed_checks.implementation: __Host- prefix + httpOnly + secure + SameSite=strict

detailed_checks.implementation: Exact origin match (not substring), prevents subdomain spoofing

detailed_checks.implementation: Generic error messages prevent token enumeration

detailed_checks.implementation: crypto.timingSafeEqual for password and token comparison

detailed_checks.implementation: HS256 algorithm with strong secret

detailed_checks.implementation: Passwords never logged, user IDs logged without sensitive fields

vector_7_rate_limiting.summary: Rate limiting properly configured with endpoint-specific limits, headers, and cleanup; in-memory store suitable for single-instance deployments

detailed_checks.implementation: Endpoint-specific limits: login 5/min, brain 10/min, protected 100/min
detailed_checks.verification: Configuration prevents brute force and DoS attacks

detailed_checks.implementation: X-RateLimit-Limit, Remaining, Reset headers on all responses
detailed_checks.verification: Clients informed of rate limit status
detailed_checks.evidence: Headers set on all responses for rate-limited endpoints

detailed_checks.implementation: 429 responses when limit exceeded
detailed_checks.verification: Proper HTTP status code for rate limiting

detailed_checks.implementation: Authentication-aware: user:id when authenticated, ip: for anonymous
detailed_checks.verification: Prevents limit bypass via multiple IPs
detailed_checks.evidence: Rate limiting uses userId if authenticated, otherwise IP

detailed_checks.implementation: In-memory store only (not distributed across multiple instances)
detailed_checks.verification: Works for single-instance deployments, fails across multiple instances
detailed_checks.recommendation: For multi-instance deployments, migrate to Redis-backed rate limiting

detailed_checks.implementation: Automatic cleanup every 60 seconds removes expired entries
detailed_checks.verification: Memory leak prevention
detailed_checks.evidence: Cleanup interval removes expired rate limit entries

detailed_checks.implementation: Time-window based reset, no sliding window weaknesses
detailed_checks.verification: Clear reset boundaries prevent window manipulation
detailed_checks.evidence: Rate limit windows expire at resetTime
